canonical_task_name: Maintain accounting records, systems, and financial reports
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. routine accounting records and financial reporting; conditional subset: SEC registrant annual or quarterly reports requiring officer certification and report signatures.
signoff_rationale: No task-wide human gate was found for routine accounting records or ordinary financial reports. SEC periodic filings create an Act-only conditional officer-certification and signature gate. Evidence: SIG-ACC01-ACQ-01; SIG-ACC01-INT-01; SIG-ACC01-DEC-01; SIG-ACC01-ACT-01.

canonical_task_name: Conduct and report audit or assurance engagements
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. audit and assurance work; conditional subset: PCAOB-governed issuer or broker-dealer engagements.
signoff_rationale: PCAOB engagements require supervised and reviewed work, engagement-partner and engagement-quality review of judgments, concurring approval, and firm signature before report use. Other assurance settings are not generalized. Evidence: SIG-ACC02-ACQ-01; SIG-ACC02-INT-01; SIG-ACC02-DEC-01; SIG-ACC02-ACT-01; SIG-ACC02-ACT-02.

canonical_task_name: Provide financial planning, analysis, and decision support
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. routine FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and management or client decision support; named transaction- or organization-specific approval regimes excluded.
signoff_rationale: No U.S.-wide legal or professional pre-effect human gate was found. Board, treasury, capital-allocation, or client approvals require a separately named scope and are not inferred here. Evidence: SIG-ACC03-ACQ-01; SIG-ACC03-INT-01; SIG-ACC03-DEC-01; SIG-ACC03-ACT-01.

canonical_task_name: Determine and document tax liabilities and filings
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. tax accounting and planning; conditional subset: preparation and paper or electronic submission of a federal tax return.
signoff_rationale: Tax research, calculation, and planning do not create a general approval gate. A filed federal return triggers taxpayer and, when applicable, paid-preparer signature or e-file authorization before transmission. Evidence: SIG-ACC04-ACQ-01; SIG-ACC04-INT-01; SIG-ACC04-DEC-01; SIG-ACC04-ACT-01; SIG-ACC04-ACT-02.

canonical_task_name: Deliver and sustain a software system or change
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. software delivery and maintenance; conditional subset: third-party software supplied for federal agency use under OMB M-22-18 and M-23-16.
signoff_rationale: No occupation-wide rule requires human approval of ordinary software stages. Covered third-party software for federal agency use requires a CEO/COO-signed secure-development attestation before agency use, creating an Act gate. Evidence: SIG-SWD01-ACQ-01; SIG-SWD01-INT-01; SIG-SWD01-DEC-01; SIG-SWD01-ACT-01.

canonical_task_name: Evaluate patients through diagnostic imaging and communicate findings
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. clinical diagnostic imaging in CMS-participating hospitals; research- and education-only use excluded; state licensure and privilege rules may add requirements.
signoff_rationale: CMS hospital rules separately require an authorized order, qualified-practitioner interpretation and clinical judgment, and an authenticated report. Evidence: SIG-RAD01-ACQ-01; SIG-RAD01-INT-01; SIG-RAD01-DEC-01; SIG-RAD01-ACT-01.

canonical_task_name: Plan and perform image-guided procedures and manage procedural care
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. clinical image-guided procedures in CMS-participating hospitals; research- and education-only use excluded; state licensure and facility privileges may add requirements.
signoff_rationale: CMS rules require an authorized order, qualified designated personnel, informed-consent controls for designated procedures, qualified procedural judgment, and authenticated documentation. Evidence: SIG-RAD02-ACQ-01; SIG-RAD02-INT-01; SIG-RAD02-DEC-01; SIG-RAD02-ACT-01.

canonical_task_name: Plan and deliver nuclear medicine diagnosis or therapy
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. clinical nuclear medicine in CMS-participating hospitals under NRC or Agreement State medical-use rules; research- and education-only use excluded.
signoff_rationale: CMS and NRC rules reserve ordering, interpretation, prescription or written-directive decisions, supervision, administration, and report authentication to authorized or qualified humans. Evidence: SIG-RAD03-ACQ-01; SIG-RAD03-INT-01; SIG-RAD03-DEC-01; SIG-RAD03-ACT-01.

signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. project planning and coordination; conditional subset: covered paid renovation in pre-1978 housing or child-occupied facilities under EPA RRP.
signoff_rationale: General construction safety oversight does not create an ordinary planning approval gate. Covered lead renovation requires certified-renovator direction, specified presence, cleaning verification, and records. Evidence: SIG-CAN47203101-ACQ-01; SIG-CAN47203101-INT-01; SIG-CAN47203101-DEC-01; SIG-CAN47203101-ACT-01.

canonical_task_name: Construct, install, and restore permanent components
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. permanent construction and restoration; conditional subset: work involving asbestos-containing or presumed asbestos-containing material under 29 CFR 1926.1101.
signoff_rationale: Covered asbestos work assigns exposure assessment, hazard interpretation, control selection or certification, and on-site supervision to a trained competent person. Evidence: SIG-CAN47203102-ACQ-01; SIG-CAN47203102-INT-01; SIG-CAN47203102-DEC-01; SIG-CAN47203102-ACT-01.

canonical_task_name: Build temporary structures and site supports
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. temporary structures and site supports; conditional subset: a covered scaffold, ladder, formwork, shoring, or related regulated variant.
signoff_rationale: Covered scaffold, ladder, formwork, and shoring rules require qualified or competent-person inspection, interpretation, design or safety decisions, and supervision or pre-use approval. Evidence: SIG-CAN47203103-ACQ-01; SIG-CAN47203103-INT-01; SIG-CAN47203103-DEC-01; SIG-CAN47203103-ACT-01.

signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. surface and interior-finish work; conditional subset: covered paid renovation disturbing painted surfaces in pre-1978 housing or child-occupied facilities under EPA RRP.
signoff_rationale: Covered lead renovation requires certified-renovator testing or documentation, lead determination, direction of work-practice decisions, specified presence, cleaning verification, and records. Evidence: SIG-CAN47203104-ACQ-01; SIG-CAN47203104-INT-01; SIG-CAN47203104-DEC-01; SIG-CAN47203104-ACT-01.

canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
signoff_applicability_scope: U.S. interstate heavy-truck freight covering conventional or SAE L0–3 human-operated CMVs and SAE L4–5 ADS-equipped CMVs within their ODD; state-only overlays excluded.
signoff_rationale: Human-operated CMV rules reserve checks, safety judgments, operation, and certifications to the driver. FMCSA permits the driver/operator concept to be satisfied without a human for SAE L4/L5 operation inside the ODD, so each human gate is conditional. Evidence: SIG-TRK01-ACQ-01; SIG-TRK01-ACQ-02; SIG-TRK01-INT-01; SIG-TRK01-INT-02; SIG-TRK01-DEC-01; SIG-TRK01-DEC-02; SIG-TRK01-ACT-01; SIG-TRK01-ACT-02.
